raw_html: [[The Falling Star]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[The Falling Star]]:''' On hit, this weapon has a chance to put down a falling star upon your foes, dealing 90d6 Fire Damage and 30d6 Bludgeoning Damage to enemies caught within the blast. This blast is so powerful it has a chance to knock nearby enemies down upon impact.
